[[Wolf (Fallout 76)|Wolves]] |robots = |quests = |terminal = |cell name =AutumnAcreCabinExt |refid ={{ID|0026161b}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMountain}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeOutdoors}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScalePOI}} |edid =SubMountainsAutumnAcreCabinLocation }} The '''Autumn Acre cabin''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Savage Divide]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== The Autumn Acre cabin is a small house precariously perched on the edge of a stunning vista in the [[Savage Divide]]. It was once the home of a romance novelist, [[G.D. Blorwood]], with a particular case of writer's block, as well as hatred for dismissive publishers.[[Mists of Autumn Acres]] Many [[Wine bottle (Fallout 76)|empty wine bottles]] were left behind by the former inhabitant. ==Layout== This quiet cabin sits on a hill overlooking the Savage Divide's border with [[the Mire]]. A pack of [[Feral ghoul (Fallout 76)|feral ghouls]] have overrun the exterior, and they can be led by a high level [[glowing one]] or [[wendigo]]. Otherwise, a pack of [[Wolf (Fallout 76)|wolves]] led by an alpha will be in the area. Inside, there is a [[steamer trunk]] and [[Suitcase (Fallout 76)|suitcase]] that can be looted in the bedroom. A number of woodpiles are scattered about the location. ==Notable loot== * [[Mists of Autumn Acres]] - Note, on a desk. * Potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] - By the restroom doorway, on a small table, next to a [[Coffee cup (Fallout 76)|coffee cup]]. * Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] - On a side table near the large stone fireplace, by the antique globe. * Potential [[Fallout 76 recipes|recipe]] - On a dresser near the entrance. ==Appearances== The Autumn Acre cabin appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== Autumn Acre Cabin.png|Exterior F76 Autumn Acre Cabin.png|Exterior FO76 Autumn Acre cabin (Mists of Autumn Acres).png|[[Mists of Autumn Acres]] FO76 Autumn Acre cabin magazine 1.jpg|Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] location (near fireplace) ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:Savage Divide locations]] [[Category:Cabins]] [[es:Cabaña Autumn Acre]] [[ru:Осенняя хижина]] [[uk:Осіння хатина]] [[zh:秋色大地小屋]]
